question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**head.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank 4 implies that when the kangaroos are chased by their predators they move toward the water.
 
• Let us now understand the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• "Return" means to go back to a place. This is incorrect with respect to the sentence.
 
• "Steer" means to control the direction that a vehicle is going in. This is not related to the sentence.
 
• "Orient" means to find out where you are. This is inappropriate with respect to the sentence.
 
• **"Head" means to move or go in a direction mentioned.**
 
 
• **This will be the correct word to use in the blank as the kangaroo also go towards the direction of the water.**
 
 
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.
